m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: So good of you to aid these Crustaceans! Poor souls. They’re not much when it comes to empire-building, but they do try!
Still though, a darker power is at work, greater than any threat this world has seen. I fear that Morganthe has returned.
Before the cataclysm, she was refused Celestia’s magic, but now I fear we have inadvertently opened the door to her.
We haven’t much time! She must be stopped before she claims the secrets of Astral magic and seizes control of the Spiral!
You must get to the bottom of this revolt. I feel the Pisceans and the Lophians are her dupes. Go into their city if you can.
You should try to pay honor to their Emperor over there. Let him make some proclamations and feel important, will you?
Greetings, surface dweller! I am the leader of the Crustacean Empire, the mightiest empire to have ever existed!
We have been betrayed from within... the Pisceans and Lophians were once our loyal allies, now they have turned against us!
As an Emperor, I could order you to aid us, but I will humbly ask this favor of you.
Would you speak to Senator Xanthus in the Senatorium and see what aid you might grant to our great empire?
The Pisceans and the Lophians have seized parts of our great capital city, which we made completely by ourselves.
Emperor Pontus, leader of the Crustacean Empire, has spoken! As it is said, so shall it be done!
Oh, good! So the Emperor finally decided to do something about this mess?
You have proven yourself a true ally, and the Emperor will be pleased at what you have done.
You should speak to your strange friend, Sir Thurston Plunkett, to learn more of our people and how great our empire is.
Speak now to Sir Plunkett. He is wise and can guide you.
